text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with yellowing of the eyes and skin; how many days old are you and was your birth uncomplicated? Did your mother have any infections like rubella or cytomegalovirus during pregnancy?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (also known as Breastfeeding Jaundice or Failure to Thrive Jaundice, though this infant's weight gain is appropriate, suggesting pure "Breastfeeding Jaundice" is more likely given the exclusive breastfeeding status). The clinical picture of a 2-week-old female with increasing jaundice, appropriate weight gain, and exclusive breastfeeding is classic for this condition. No further tests are required at this moment.
